House Building
Advances to Officers
of India Services
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹12.50
lakh was the net effect
of increase of ₹150.00
lakh and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹137.50 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amounts
for home construction
advance. Decrease was
attributed to non-receipt
of proposal.
